# Evidence datasets

`development-contract.json` contains deterministic output-validation fixtures. Unit tests inject model output; these are mocks, not local-model accuracy measurements. They informed the validator and cannot be scored as fresh holdouts.

`tuning/` is reserved for later prompt/validator tuning. No tuning corpus has been used in this build. If a failed holdout is used to change behavior, that dataset becomes development data; freeze a new holdout before another accuracy claim.

`fresh-holdout-v1.json` contains internal synthetic cases written in a separate delegated task before live inference. The author did not open development, tuning, or task-3 benchmark case files, but shared conversation history included the earlier benchmark report and failure summaries. These are internal checks authored alongside the implementation, never the parent independent unseen holdout. They declare expected labels and acceptable full exact evidence sentences. `FRESH-HOLDOUT.md` records the protocol and limitations. The runner never sends these gold labels or quotes to the model. Raw per-case results and failures belong in `artifacts/model-check/`, never in this fixture directory.

The older task-3 benchmark is preserved unchanged. Its reported 28/30 labels and 27/30 audited contracts are background feasibility results, not scores for this module or dataset. A small English synthetic set does not establish real seller reliability, broad instruction detection, truth, provenance, or authenticity.

The deterministic checks preserve complete sentence/line context, reject instruction-like seller text, and reject selected explicit uncertainty, negation, replacement, topic and number conflicts. These conservative English heuristics can reject legitimate text and cannot prove semantic support. Accepted evidence still needs the buyer's explicit review.

The runner records attempts without responses separately from model-only scores. With `--owns-model-use`, an empty residency preflight and parent authorization permit cleanup of the fixed Qwen model after any attempted inference, including a timeout that may have loaded weights. A blocked residency preflight makes no inference or unload request.

`independent-holdout-v1.json` was the parent's first independent set, run once against frozen v1. It is now exposed: any v2 run is an exposed regression, never fresh accuracy. Exact Unicode inputs and first raw output are preserved under `artifacts/model-check/v1/`; the input byte audit found no text deviations. Only the badge text of the budget case went to the model; trusted cents and stale-payment behavior have separate backend tests.

`audit-scope-regressions.json` and `evidence-v2.test.mjs` contain synthetic developer/source-review proposals. Their provenance is explicit; they informed v2 and are not independent accuracy evidence. The historical 50 v1 tests import the preserved module, while current v2 tests separately exercise its context policy, scope guards and shared transport contract.

Frozen v2 (`2026-10-10-v2`) permits exact eligible relevant unknown context; quote-integrity validation does not turn unknown into a known decision. Known quotes may span bounded contiguous complete sentences or lines. Instruction-governed text and general decision claims are excluded with a visible notice. Unsupported known model proposals are visibly withheld, and malformed, altered or ineligible quotes remain empty. These policy changes make v1/v2 contract percentages incomparable without the per-case raw and delivered audit. The runner records both separately and refuses to label either exposed v1 dataset as a fresh independent check.

Use `--evidence-version v1` to route to the preserved module and v1 freeze, or the default `v2` to check the current frozen module. Choose `--evaluation exposed-regression`, `fresh-independent`, `internal-synthetic` or `runner-mock` explicitly when reporting results. The runner captures installed Qwen manifest/quantization metadata without starting the service, never sends gold expectations to the model, and records cleanup after attempted isolated inference.

`independent-holdout-v2.json` contains the parent's eight exact cases supplied after the immutable v2 freeze. Each complete buyer statement was one requirement, with unchanged supplied labels and pre-run gold quote criteria. Its first and only frozen-v2 evaluation is preserved in `artifacts/model-check/independent-holdout-v2.json` and audited in `INDEPENDENT-V2-RESULTS.md`: raw 5/8 labels, delivered 2/8 labels and 1/8 contracts, one accepted false contradiction. These cases are now exposed. Any future tuned rerun must use `--evaluation exposed-regression`; it cannot be called fresh accuracy. Packaging-type ambiguity in case 7 is recorded separately without changing the supplied Match or failure score. No v2 code or prompt change followed this result.
